8873570.verdict: Research agrees with the lineup: one move -- start Nabers over Vele. RB/FLEX: Kyren, Achane, Hubbard are ranked RB13-15 by the expert consensus, all well ahead of Vele (flex #65). Optional small upgrades: Giants D/ST and kicker Daniel Carlson from free agency.

players.Justin Herbert: Only QB on the roster. LAC at BUF: dry, light wind, 50.5 total -- good passing spot.
players.Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Consensus WR1. 11 targets, 9-155-3 in Week 2. Wind 18-20 mph in Washington but he's a must-start.
players.Malik Nabers: Consensus WR18 (experts range WR12-23), 21% target share and first read. Shoulder cleared (full practice Thu/Fri). Risk: Winston at QB (40.7% completions in relief) and the week's worst weather -- 17-23 mph wind, gusts ~40, 90% rain. Still ahead of Vele/Wilson; if he's inactive, start Vele.
players.Devaughn Vele: WR29 but best bench WR: dome game, LV allows the 2nd-most yards per target to slot WRs. First backup if Nabers sits.
players.Michael Wilson: WR28 by rank but tough matchup -- SF allows the 7th-fewest points per target to outside WRs; the FantasyPros Primer says sit.
players.Kyren Williams: RB13. Denver has allowed the 4th-most fantasy points to RBs (220 rush yds to KC in Week 1). Splits some work with Corum. Plays Sunday night.
players.De'Von Achane: RB14. 83% snap share, 11 targets in 2 games protect his PPR floor. Miami is a 10.5-pt underdog vs a top-10 run defense -- lower ceiling.
players.Chuba Hubbard: RB15. Lead back with Jonathon Brooks on IR; small favorite vs a middling Cleveland run defense. Only 10-12 carries a game so far.
players.TreVeyon Henderson: RB29. Split with Stevenson, zero targets in Week 2, tough Jacksonville run defense. Bench.
players.Kaelon Black: RB37, McCaffrey's backup (McCaffrey practiced fully). Bench.
players.Tyler Warren: Consensus TE9, must-start per the FantasyPros Primer.
players.Oronde Gadsden: TE16. Growing role with Njoku and Kolar out, but Buffalo is tough on TEs. Bench.
players.Chris Boswell: Pittsburgh wind 12-14 mph, gusts to 21, dry -- a mild knock for a kicker.
players.Bengals D/ST: Faces Aaron Rodgers' Steelers in dry conditions; 8.0 projected.

waivers: Optional: add Giants D/ST (free agent, 8.5 projected) -- home vs the 0-2 Titans in the week's worst storm (lowest total on the board, 38.5). Storms favor defenses. Drop Kaelon Black to make room and start the Giants over the Bengals.
Optional: kicker Daniel Carlson (free agent, NO, 8.8 projected) kicks indoors as a 3-pt favorite vs Boswell (8.3) in wind. Small gain -- swap only if the add is free.

250898504.verdict: Start Shough over Nix and Fannin over Hockenson (both confirmed by expert ranks). Best move this week: three free-agent pickups -- Parker Washington (WR9), Dalton Schultz (TE6) and Brandon Aubrey (K1) all outrank what you'd start. With them: QB Shough, RB Walker + Taylor, FLEX Achane, WR Olave + Washington, TE Schultz, K Aubrey, D/ST Rams.

players.Tyler Shough: QB10 by expert consensus. 410 yds/3 TD in Week 1, rushing TD in Week 2. Dome game, Saints favored by 3.
players.Bo Nix: QB16. Rushing has disappeared (5 yds total in 2 games). Also plays against your Rams D/ST -- starting both works against itself. Bench (or drop).
players.Kenneth Walker III: Top RB this week (290 rush yds, 6.2 YPC through 2 games); Chiefs are 10.5-pt favorites.
players.De'Von Achane: RB14: 83% of snaps, steady targets. Miami is a big underdog, which caps the ceiling. FLEX.
players.Chris Olave: Dome game vs LV; projects ~17.8. Start.
players.Davante Adams: WR11. 8-195-2 in Week 2 with Nacua out, and Nacua is doubtful again. Start if you don't add Parker Washington.
players.George Pickens: WR13. Highest-total game (53.5 in Rio), but only 68 yds and no TDs so far; rain on a re-stitched field is the worry.
players.Mike Evans: WR15 but QUESTIONABLE (hip): missed Wed/Thu practice, limited Fri. 4:05 game -- risky.
players.Jalen Coker: WR22, QUESTIONABLE (ankle), expected to play. 16 catches in 2 games.
players.Malik Nabers: WR18, but the week's worst storm (17-23 mph wind, 90% rain) and Jameis Winston at QB. Bench here -- you have better options.
TE13, 8 spots above Hockenson. Start if you don't add Schultz.
players.T.J. Hockenson: TE21: only 4-5 targets a game even with a good matchup at TB. Bench (or drop for Schultz).
players.Rams D/ST: DST10 -- a fine mid-tier start at DEN (Broncos scored 10 and 20). 49ers D/ST (free agent, DST6) is only a slight upgrade.
players.Chris Boswell: K17 with 12-14 mph wind in Pittsburgh. Swap for Aubrey (K1).
players.TreVeyon Henderson: RB29, split backfield, tough Jacksonville run defense. Bench.

waivers: Add Parker Washington (WR, JAX) -- expert rank WR9, above every WR you have; 42.9% target share in Week 2 (highest of any WR). Start him over Adams. Drop Bo Nix to make room -- free-agent QBs (Lawrence, Kyler Murray) project as well as Nix if you ever need a fill-in.
Add Dalton Schultz (TE, HOU) -- TE6; 14 targets in Week 2, Nico Collins is out, and Indianapolis gave up 304 and 371 passing yds. Start him; drop Hockenson.
Add Brandon Aubrey (K, DAL) -- K1 in the week's highest-total game. Drop Boswell (K17).
